item.title: Version 1.2.30 (Build 20261126)
item.description:
What's New

fix(telex): keep non-Vietnamese words literal while typing

Stop applying Vietnamese marks to words whose structure proves they can

never be Vietnamese: restore the raw keystrokes on the keystroke where the

vowel group or final consonant run becomes impossible, and pin the rest of

the word literal.

  • VowelSequenceValidator.isExtendableOrValid: prefix-extendable check.
  • Loanword vowel groups (cooc, khoao, palang) exempt; 'l' treated as an

extendable medial; all-caps no longer exempt so "SEAR" stays literal.

  • Never re-judge a buffer restored by backspace (handleDelete), skip

vRestore undo states, and obey the cursor/focus/desync flags.

  • Replace exactly the displayed characters (buffer.count before the

event), rebuild keystrokes with fresh entryIds, rebuild macroKey, respect

MAX_BUFF/overflow, and clear hookState.code so saveWord still runs.

  • 12 regression tests: ProcessResult shape, backspace-after-restore,

uppercase/mixed case, loanword groups, desync flags, custom consonants,

VNI.

Corpus restore_raw 3776 -> 5861/7217; English transient flash

66786 -> 64674/235976 under the guard's reach.
